blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: When an LLM group's discussion is compressed into a short memory for a final decision maker, what should the memory keep? Two natural heuristics keep the rarest claims or the claims relevant to the decision criteria. On hidden-profile tasks both look attractive, because how widely a fact is held is confounded with whether it helps. We introduce CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark of 60 templates with automatically verified answer keys, in which the ownership of supporting, decoy, and irrelevant facts is crossed while their text is held fixed (480 tasks). Across Qwen2.5-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and two DeepSeek models, both heuristics fail in predictable places. Selecting by relevance readmits decoys, because decoys are on topic: even a perfect relevance filter loses 23 to 31 points to rarest-first selection in the classic hidden-profile configuration. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average and wins only where the rare facts happen to be the useful ones. In both cases accuracy follows the balance of evidence the memory keeps, not the policy that kept it. The decision model adds a third failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to facts attributed to many agents. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random with line order fixed, raises accuracy in the classic configuration by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions the evidence is lost before any memory acts: the complete transcript yields lower accuracy than no notes at all.
blocks.zh: 当一个LLM组的讨论被压缩成一个短暂的内存,一个最终的决策者,记忆应该保存什么? 两项自然休克令保留了最罕见的索赔或与决定标准相关的索赔。 在隐蔽的任务中,两者看起来都具有吸引力,因为一个事实的持有程度之广令人怀疑它是否有帮助。 我们引入了CrossProfile,这是60个模板的诊断基准,其中自动验证了答案密钥,其中在文本被固定(480个任务)时会跨越支持,诱饵和无关事实的所有权. 横跨了Quen2.5-7B,Llama-3.1-8B,以及两个"DeepSeek"模型,两种heuristic在可以预测的地方都失败了. 由关联再投寄出诱饵来选择,因为诱饵在话题上:甚至一个完美的关联性过滤器也损失了23到31分,成为经典的隐形配置中最罕见的首选. 稀有先入为主的选择并不比平均随机选择好,只有在罕见的事实恰好有用的情况下才会取胜. 在这两种情况下,准确性都遵循存储器所保存的证据的平衡,而不是保存它的政策。 裁决模式增加了第三种失败,一种社会证明形式:它赋予许多代理人的事实额外分量. 删除归属标记,或随行顺序固定而随机再分配,使经典配置的精度提高13到24分. 在自然讨论中,在任何记忆行为发生之前,证据都丢失了:完整的记录稿的准确性低于没有任何记录。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: An agent team may hold all the evidence needed for a decision and still leave its final reader with the wrong information. Some evidence is never stated. Other evidence is stated and then lost when a memory policy compresses the discussion. Even a faithful memory can emphasize claims that the reader weighs poorly. An end-task accuracy gain alone cannot tell these failure points apart.
blocks.zh: 代理人小组可以掌握决定所需的一切证据,但仍将错误的信息留给最后读者。 有些证据从未被陈述过。 其他证据在记忆政策压缩讨论时被陈述,然后丢失. 即使是忠实的记忆,也可以强调读者的重量不佳的说法. 仅凭结束任务精度的提高无法分辨这些失败点。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Rarity and decision usefulness. Fact text stays fixed while the ownership of support and decoy facts changes; here irrelevant facts stay private. Filled dots mark the agents holding each fact, and the boxes on the right show what rarest-first selection prioritizes. (c) The three ownership factors are crossed. Decoys are true, criterion-relevant facts that favor a competing option. Role labels are never shown to the models.
blocks.zh: 图1:瑞丽和决策效用。 事实文本保持不变,而支持和欺骗事实的所有权却在改变;在此,无关的事实是保密的。 填充点标记了代理持有每个事实,右边的盒子显示的是最罕见的首选优先. (c) 跨越三个所有权因素。 欺骗是真实的,与标准相关的事实,有利于相互竞争的选择. 角色标签从不向模型显示.

blocks.en: Hidden-profile tasks make the distinction concrete: participants share some facts and individually hold other facts needed for a collective decision ( Stasser and Titus 1985 ; Gigone and Hastie 1993 ; Li, Naito, and Shirado 2026 ) . A natural response to repeated shared information is to preserve what few participants said. We study this response through rarest-first selection (R1), which ranks claims by the number of agents who stated them. The rule assumes that rare evidence is worth keeping.
blocks.zh: 隐藏的任务使区别具体化:参与者分享一些事实,并单独掌握集体决定所需的其他事实(Stasser和Titus,1985年;Gigone和Hastie,1993年;Li、Naito和Shirado,2026年)。 对反复共享信息的自然反应是保留少数与会者所说的话。 我们通过最罕见的第一选择(R1)来研究这一反应,该选择将索赔按陈述这些索赔的代理人数量排序。 该规则假定,稀有的证据值得保存。

blocks.en: Faithfulness alone does not settle which evidence to keep. In one procurement template, a supplier has passed every electrical safety inspection but took nine days to answer urgent repair callouts. Both statements concern the decision criteria. Keeping the favorable fact and dropping the unfavorable one can change the decision without introducing any false claim. What matters is the balance of the retained evidence, not only whether a summary is accurate.
blocks.zh: 忠诚并不能解决哪些证据需要保存的问题。 在一个采购模板中,一个供应商通过了每次电气安全检查,但用了9天时间来回答紧急的修理要求。 这两份声明都涉及决定标准。 保留有利的事实和放弃不利的事实可以改变决定而不提出任何虚假主张。 重要的是保留证据的平衡,而不仅仅是一份摘要是否准确。

blocks.en: Figure 1 shows why the rarity assumption needs testing. In a classic hidden profile, private evidence supports the correct answer and shared evidence favors a decoy. Prioritizing rare facts can then help by keeping support, by excluding decoys, or both. If private facts instead favor the decoy, the same rule can damage the decision. On HiddenBench the two explanations cannot be separated: a memory holding only the private facts reaches 91% accuracy on Qwen, whereas one holding only the shared facts reaches 6%, well below an empty memory. A large gain for rarest-first selection there therefore says little about rarity itself. The obvious alternative, keeping the facts relevant to the decision criteria, faces the opposite problem, because a decoy is relevant by construction. Testing either rule requires a design in which fact prevalence and decision usefulness vary independently.
blocks.zh: 图1显示为什么罕见的假设需要测试。 在一个经典的隐藏剖面中,私人证据支持正确的答案,共享的证据偏向于一个诱饵. 然后,将稀有事实列为优先事项有助于保持支持,排除诱饵,或两者兼而有之。 如果私人事实倾向于诱饵,同样的规则会损害裁决。 在Hidden Bench上,两个解释不能分开:一个只持有私人事实的记忆在Quen上达到91%的准确度,而一个只持有共同事实的记忆达到6%,远远低于一个空的记忆. 因此,最难得的首选获得的巨额收益,很少提到稀有性本身。 显而易见的替代办法是保留与决定标准相关的事实,但面临相反的问题,因为一个诱饵与建筑有关。 测试任何一条规则都要求设计,在设计中,事实普遍程度和决定的有用性独立不同。

blocks.en: We construct CrossProfile, a crossed benchmark in which support, decoy, and irrelevant facts are each either shared or private. Within a template, the fact sentences and their decision roles are fixed across all eight ownership variants, and the answer key follows from the fact roles and is verified automatically. Scripted discussions state every assigned fact, so memory selection can be studied against a known inventory. CrossProfile is a diagnostic benchmark: it isolates what a memory policy and a decision model do with a known set of evidence. Changing ownership also changes when a fact first appears, the holder tags attached to it, and its token cost, and we add a control for each of these.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了CrossProfile,一个跨度基准,在这个基准中,支持、诱饵和无关的事实要么是共享的,要么是私人的。 在一个模板中,事实句子及其决定角色在所有8个所有权变体中固定下来,答案键从事实角色开始,并自动被验证. 脚本讨论说明了每一个指定的事实,因此可以对照已知的目录来研究内存选择. CrossProfile是一个诊断基准:它隔离了记忆政策和决策模型与已知的一组证据的关系. 改变所有权也会随着一个事实的首次出现而改变,随附的持有者标记,以及它的象征性成本,我们对这些每一个都增加了一个控制.

blocks.en: Both heuristics fail in cells that the design predicts, and aggregate accuracy hides both failures. Relevance-first selection helps on average but loses 20 to 32 points in the classic hidden-profile cell, and a perfect relevance filter loses as much, because relevance does not distinguish support from decoys. Rarest-first selection is no better than random selection on average; its advantage over random selection changes by 28 to 41 points depending on who holds the decoys, on all four models. Across policies, accuracy rises steadily with the net evidence lead of the correct option among the kept facts, and once that lead is known the policy adds little. The decision model contributes a separate failure, a form of social proof: it gives extra weight to a fact attributed to many agents, although in our tasks shared facts were assigned, not independently observed. Removing the attribution tags, or reassigning them at random while keeping line order, raises its all-facts accuracy in the classic cell by 13 to 24 points. In natural discussions no memory policy beats another and the full transcript is less useful than an empty memory, so the evidence is lost before any memory acts.
blocks.zh: 两种heuristic在设计预测的细胞中都失败,而聚合精度掩盖了两种失败. 关联性第一选择平均帮助了经典隐形单元格的20至32分,完美的关联性过滤器损失同样多,因为关联性并不区分支持和诱饵. 稀有第一选择并不比平均随机选择好;它比随机选择的优势变化了28到41分,取决于谁持有诱饵,在所有四个模型上. 在所有政策中,准确性稳步提高,在所保留的事实中,有正确选择的净证据导致准确选择,而一旦知道这一引导,政策就没有什么增加。 裁决模式造成一种单独的失败,一种社会证明:它赋予许多代理人的事实额外的份量,尽管在我们的任务中分配了共同的事实,但没有独立观察。 删除归属标记,或者在保持行序的同时随机重新分配,在经典单元格中将其全事实精度提高13至24分. 在自然的讨论中,没有记忆政策胜过另一个,完整的记录稿比空的记忆更无用,因此证据在任何记忆行动之前就丢失了.

blocks.en: Our contributions are (i) CrossProfile, a diagnostic benchmark that varies the ownership of support, decoy, and irrelevant facts while holding their content fixed; (ii) evidence on two open and two hosted models, with random-reference, fixed-item-count, and oracle-relevance controls, that relevance and rarity both fail in predictable ownership cells because neither tracks the balance of evidence; (iii) evidence that the decision model follows social proof in the form of holder tags, isolated from line order; and (iv) natural-discussion evidence that the main bottleneck lies upstream of memory.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(一) CrossProfile,这个诊断基准在固定内容的同时,改变了对支持、诱饵和无关事实的所有权;(二) 两个公开和两个主机模型的证据,并附有随机参考、固定项目计数和甲骨文相关性控制,这种相关性和罕见性在可预测的所有权细胞中都未能实现,因为两者都无法跟踪证据的平衡;(三) 证明决定模型遵循的是持有者标记形式的社会证明,与行序无关;(四) 自然讨论证据表明主要瓶颈位于记忆的上游。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Hidden-profile research documents shared-information bias and the difficulty of pooling distributed evidence ( Stasser and Titus 1985 ; Gigone and Hastie 1993 ; Lu, Yuan, and McLeod 2012 ) ; in the common-knowledge effect, information held by more members carries more weight in the group judgment ( Gigone and Hastie 1993 ) , and our decision model shows a similar weighting from holder tags alone. LLM agents in opinion simulations can also violate basic probabilistic consistency, assigning probabilities to a claim and to its negation that do not add up to one ( Imel and Qi 2026 ) . HiddenBench adapts this setting to LLM groups and examines forced disclosure, passive summarization, and structured communication ( Li, Naito, and Shirado 2026 ) . With human groups, an LLM facilitator increases how much information members share without improving the final decision ( Alsobay et al. 2025 ) , which parallels our finding that disclosure and use of evidence are separate bottlenecks. Our intervention holds fact content fixed while crossing the ownership of decision roles, and studies what survives a memory constraint applied after the discussion.
blocks.zh: 隐藏的研究文件共享信息偏差以及收集分布式证据的困难(Stasser和Titus 1985;Gigone和Hastie 1993;Lu、Yuan和McLeod 2012;在共同知识效应中,更多成员持有的信息在集体判断(Gigone和Hastie 1993)中具有更大的份量,我们的决定模式显示,仅持有者标记者就有类似的份量。 舆论模拟中的LLM剂也可能违反基本概率一致性,将概率分配给一项主张及其否定,两者加起来不等于一项(Imel和Qi 2026). Hidden Bench将这个设置适应LLM群, 与人类群体相比,一个LLM协调人增加了成员在不改进最后决定的情况下共享的信息量(Assobay等人,2025年),这与我们关于披露和使用证据是单独瓶颈的结论相似。 我们的干预在跨越决策角色的主人翁地位的同时,将事实内容固定下来,并研究在讨论之后所应用的记忆约束中生存下来的因素。

blocks.en: Multi-agent debate and agent frameworks study reasoning through interaction ( Du et al. 2024 ; Smit et al. 2024 ; Wu et al. 2024 ) , and collective biases in LLM groups can change non-linearly with group size ( Flint et al. 2026 ) , which our fixed four-agent design does not vary. Consilience intervenes during hidden-profile communication with a calibrated controller that tracks evidence and redundancy ( Babu et al. 2026 ) . Communication interventions change what the group discloses; memory selection, which we study, determines which disclosed claims reach the final reader.
blocks.zh: 多代理辩论和代理框架通过互动研究推理(Du et al. 2024; Smit等人著. 2024; Wu et al. 2024),和LLM群的集体偏差可以随群大小而改变非线性(Flint et al. 2026),我们固定的四剂设计没有变化. 与跟踪证据和冗余的校准控制器进行隐形通信时的配合干预(Babu等人,2026年). 沟通干预会改变群体披露的内容;我们研究的内存选择会决定哪些披露的诉求到达最终读者.

blocks.en: Memory architectures maintain information across interactions ( Packer et al. 2023 ; Park et al. 2023 ) , and prompt compression and selective context address limited capacity ( Jiang et al. 2023 ; Li et al. 2023 ) . Benchmarks of conversational memory test long-horizon recall ( Maharana et al. 2024 ) , and recent multi-party benchmarks show that memory pipelines lose speaker and group structure ( Yang et al. 2026 ; Hu et al. 2026 ) ; CrossProfile instead asks which evidence a compressed memory should keep for a downstream decision. Interaction-aware selection argues that records can matter only in combination ( Subrahmanyam and Choudhary 2026 ) , which is consistent with our finding that decisions follow the balance of the kept evidence rather than the merit of individual facts. Position effects further separate available evidence from evidence the model uses ( Liu et al. 2024 ) ; our tag controls hold line order fixed to separate attribution from position.
blocks.zh: 内存结构在互动中保持信息 (Packer等人著). 2023;Park等人 2023),以及快速压缩和选择性上下文解决能力有限的问题(Jiang等人 2023;Li等人 2023). 对话记忆测试长视距召回的基准(Maharana等人,2024年),近期多党基准显示记忆管道失去扬声器和群结构(Yang等人,2026年;Hu等人,2026年);CrossProfile转而询问压缩记忆应该保存哪些证据,以便下游决定. 互动意识选择认为,记录只能组合在一起(Subrahmanyam和Choudhary 2026)才重要,这与我们的结论是一致的,即决定遵循的是保留证据的平衡,而不是个别事实的优点。 位置效应将现有证据与模型使用的证据进一步分离(Liu等人,2024年);我们的标记控制持有固定的线序,将归属与位置区分开来.

blocks.en: 3 Setting and Memory Policies
blocks.zh: 3 设置和记忆政策

blocks.en: Figure 2: Pipeline. Facts from template M01 (Table 4 ) are distributed among the agents; HiddenBench tasks have three or four agents and CrossProfile tasks have four. After the discussion, a memory policy compresses it under a token budget B B , either by summarizing the transcript (B3) or by selecting whole claims from a claim inventory (R1, R1-rel, B4, Random). A separate call with the same model weights answers from the task and the memory alone.
blocks.zh: 图2:管道。 模板M01(表4)中的事实分布在代理商之间;隐藏奔驰任务有三四个代理商,CrossProfile任务有四个代理商. 经讨论后,一项记忆政策通过汇总记录(B3)或从索赔清单(R1、R1-rel、B4、Random)中选取全部索赔,在象征性预算B.B.项下对其进行压缩。 单用相同的模型加权单独调用任务和内存给出答案.

blocks.en: 3.1 Discussion, Memory, and Decision
blocks.zh: 3.1 讨论、记忆和决定

blocks.en: A task specifies a description, candidate answers, and facts assigned to agents. A shared fact is held by every agent; a private fact is held by one. After the discussion, a memory policy constructs a memory for a separate decision call, which receives only the description, the options, and the memory. The decision call uses the same model weights as the discussion and sees the full transcript only in the REF control. Answer keys and role labels are withheld from all generation and from every memory policy except the oracle-relevance control.
blocks.zh: 一项任务规定了描述、候选答案和指派给代理人的事实。 每个代理人都持有一个共同的事实;一个私人的事实由一个人持有。 讨论结束后,一个记忆政策为单独的决策呼叫构建一个记忆,只接收描述,选项,以及记忆. 决定调用使用与讨论相同的模型权重,并且只在REF控制中看到完整记录. 除甲骨文关联控制外,所有代数和每个内存政策都不保留答案密钥和角色标签.

blocks.en: In controlled HiddenBench discussions, each agent is scripted to state its assigned facts. Natural discussions consist of initial individual votes, two rounds of messages, and final votes; memories are built from the messages, not the votes. Copy policies select from a known claim inventory in the controlled condition and from an extracted inventory in the natural condition. In extracted inventories, a claim’s contributors are the agents who stated it, which need not coincide with the agents who originally held the underlying fact. The summary policy B3 reads the transcript directly. Figure 2 summarizes these paths.
blocks.zh: 在受控的隐藏奔驰讨论中,每个代理被脚本来说明其指定的事实. 自然讨论包括最初的个人投票,两轮信息,以及最后的投票;记忆是建立在信息而不是选票上的. 复制保单,从控制状态下已知的索赔清单和自然状态下提取的清单中选择。 在提取的库存清单中,索赔的出资者是提出该索赔的代理人,这不一定与最初掌握基本事实的代理人相吻合。 简要政策B3直接阅读记录。 图2概述了这些路径。

blocks.en: 3.2 The CrossProfile Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3.2 跨文件基准

blocks.en: CrossProfile has 60 main templates, five in each of 12 decision domains. Each template has four agents, three options, and 12 facts: five support, three decoy, and four irrelevant. Support facts favor the correct option, including negative evidence about the decoy option. Decoy facts favor the competing option, including negative evidence about the correct option. Both concern the stated decision criteria; decoys are true statements whose partial implication is misleading. Irrelevant facts concern other attributes and may be positive or negative in tone. Each role group is independently shared or private, yielding 2 3 2^{3} ownership variants and 480 derived tasks. Ten pilot templates are excluded from all main estimates.
blocks.zh: CrossProfile有60个主模板,12个决定域中每个模板5个. 每个模板有4个代理,3个选项,以及12个事实:5个支持,3个诱饵,4个无关紧要. 支持事实支持正确的选项,包括诱饵选项的负面证据. 欺骗性事实倾向于相互竞争的选择,包括对正确选择的负面证据. 两者都涉及所述决定标准;诱饵是真实的言论,其部分含义具有误导性。 与此无关的事实涉及其他属性,在语气上可能是正面或负面的. 每个角色组都是独立共享或私有的,产生2 3 2^{3}所有权变体和480个衍生任务. 所有主要估计数不包括10个试点模板。

blocks.en: The answer key follows from the structured facts: each favorable fact adds one to its option’s score, each unfavorable fact subtracts one, and irrelevant facts contribute zero. An automatic verifier checks every template for a unique best option over all facts, a decoy win when only decoy facts are counted, a correct-option win when only support facts are counted, and the absence of hint words; all 70 templates pass. With the fixed fact counts, the keyed option scores + 2 +2 over all facts and each competitor scores 0 0 . The task description asks for the best overall record on equally weighted criteria, but the decision prompt does not state the scoring rule. Accuracy therefore measures agreement with this constructed key.
blocks.zh: 答案的关键来自于结构化的事实:每个有利的事实在其选择的分数中都增加了一个,每个不合适的事实减去一个,不相关的事实贡献为零。 自动验证者检查每个模板,以获得一个针对所有事实的独特的最佳选择,当只计算欺骗事实时,一个诱饵胜出,当只计算支持事实时,一个正确选择胜出,没有提示词;所有70个模板都通过. 以固定的事实计数,按键选项在所有事实中得分+2+2,每个竞争对手得分0. 任务说明要求在同等加权标准上有最佳的总体记录,但裁决及时没有说明评分规则。 因此,准确性可以衡量与这一构筑钥匙的协议。

blocks.en: The controlled transcript randomizes the speaking order and the order of each speaker’s facts. Every shared fact appears in the first speaker’s turn, although not necessarily before every private fact in that turn, so first-mention selection is sensitive to prevalence. Copied memory lines keep their contributor tags and follow the policy’s selection order. Ownership thus changes how evidence is presented as well as its selection priority.

blocks.en: R1 orders claims by increasing contributor count, breaking ties by first appearance. B4 orders claims by first appearance alone. Random orders the same inventory uniformly at random. These copy policies add whole claims in this order until the budget is reached, skipping any claim that would exceed it.
blocks.zh: R1通过增加贡献者数量来订购索赔,通过初次出现打破联系. B4单凭初次出庭就提出订单索赔. 随机随机统一订购同一存货. 这些复制单按此顺序加上全部索赔,直到达到预算为止,省略任何超出预算的索赔。

blocks.en: B3 , the evidence-preserving summary, asks the model to keep each distinct piece of evidence with its conditions, uncertainty, and disagreements. It receives a word limit derived from the budget, and longer outputs are truncated to the budget. R1-rel first asks the model which fact texts concern the stated criteria. This filter sees the description, options, and fact texts, but no holders, answers, or role labels. Claims predicted relevant form the first tier and the remaining claims the second, with R1 order inside each tier; second-tier claims remain eligible. Since decoys concern the criteria, they are relevant by this definition.

blocks.en: We use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct ( Qwen Team 2024 ; Llama Team, AI @ Meta 2024 ) , served locally with vLLM ( Kwon et al. 2023 ) in fp16 with an 8,192-token context and seeds 17, 42, and 91. Decisions, summaries, and claim extraction use temperature zero. Natural discussion messages use temperature 0.7, top- p p 0.9, and at most 256 output tokens; decisions allow 400 output tokens. HiddenBench contributes 65 tasks, 58 with four agents and 7 with three. We also evaluate two hosted models through the DeepSeek API at temperature zero with thinking disabled: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on all 60 CrossProfile templates and on natural HiddenBench discussions, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on 30 templates. Appendices A.1 and A.7 give all prompts and further implementation details.

blocks.en: 5.1 HiddenBench Confounds Rarity with Usefulness
blocks.zh: 5.1 隐藏的奔驰与实用性

blocks.en: On controlled HiddenBench, R1 is far ahead of the other memories (Table 1 ). At r = .6 r=.6 it reaches 88.2% on Qwen and 87.7% on Llama, against 51.3% and 59.0% for the evidence summary B3; averaged over budgets, R1 minus B3 is + 29.2 +29.2 points [22.9, 35.4] and + 26.7 +26.7 [20.2, 33.2], and rebuilding R1 at each summary’s realized length leaves + 25.6 +25.6 and + 25.8 +25.8 (Appendix Table 16 ). Table 1 also shows what R1 selects: nearly all private facts and few shared ones. Two reference memories show why this pays off. A memory of only the private facts reaches 91.3% on Qwen and 90.3% on Llama, above the all-facts memory by + 21.5 +21.5 [13.3, 30.3] and + 28.7 +28.7 [17.9, 39.0] points, whereas a memory of only the shared facts reaches 5.6% and 4.6%, far below an empty memory in the same run (35.4% and 36.4%). In HiddenBench the shared facts point to a wrong option, so dropping them is what helps, and no task has rare facts that mislead. CrossProfile adds such tasks.

CrossProfile 添加了这样的任务 。

blocks.en: 5.2 Rarity Is a Bet on Who Holds the Decoys
blocks.zh: 5.2 瑞瑞是打赌谁持有诱饵

blocks.en: Averaged over all ownership variants of CrossProfile, R1 is no better than Random: 64.0% against 64.5% on Qwen and 63.0% against 63.4% on Llama (Table 2 ). This average hides a reversal across cells. When support is private and decoys are shared, R1 reaches 90 to 97% while first-mention selection (B4) falls to 11 to 31%; when support is shared and decoys are private, the order reverses, with B4 at 92 to 96% and R1 at 18 to 40% (Figure 3 ).

blocks.en: The pre-specified H1 measures this dependence of the R1 advantage over B4 on decoy ownership: + 64.6 +64.6 points [60.3, 69.0] for Qwen and + 62.6 +62.6 [56.8, 68.2] for Llama, both Holm p < .001 p<.001 (Appendix Figure 6 ). Because every shared claim appears in the first turn, B4 keeps shared facts first and is close to a mirror image of R1, so part of H1 is built into the reference. Against Random, the interaction is + 40.7 +40.7 [34.6, 47.1] and + 34.2 +34.2 [27.8, 41.0]; when both policies retain exactly seven facts, H1 is + 66.8 +66.8 [61.9, 71.7] and + 72.6 +72.6 [67.2, 78.1]. The hosted models show the same pattern. On DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, H1 is + 62.6 +62.6 [56.7, 68.6] and the interaction against Random is + 28.3 +28.3 [22.1, 34.7]; on a 30-template run of DeepSeek-V4-Pro the latter is + 30.6 +30.6 [22.5, 38.6]. On that common subset, R1 minus Random averaged over variants is − 1.7 -1.7 , + 1.7 +1.7 , − 1.3 -1.3 , and − 4.7 -4.7 points on Qwen, Llama, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and DeepSeek-V4-Pro.

blocks.en: 5.3 Relevant Is Not Useful

blocks.en: H3 supports relevance-first priority on average: + 8.5 +8.5 points [3.5, 13.6] for Qwen (Holm p = .002 p=.002 ), + 15.6 +15.6 [11.1, 19.9] for Llama ( p < .001 p<.001 ), and + 16.7 +16.7 [12.8, 20.7] on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and R1-rel has the highest mean among budgeted policies (Table 2 ). We expected no benefit when irrelevant facts are shared, but the gains are + 8.7 +8.7 [4.6, 12.8] and + 7.6 +7.6 [4.2, 11.2]: when all facts are shared, rarity cannot separate irrelevant facts from criterion-related ones, and the relevance tier does.
blocks.zh: H3支持关联性第一优先:Qen(Holm p =.002 p =.002),Llama(p < 001 p < 001),以及DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash),+8.5+8.5分[3.5,13.6],R1-rel在预算政策中的平均值最高(表2)。 如果分享不相关事实,我们预计没有好处,但收益是+8.7+8.7[4.6,12.8]和+7.6+7.6[4.2,11.2]:如果分享所有事实,很少将不相关事实与标准相关事实区分开来,而且关联级别确实如此。

blocks.en: The average combines gains with a large loss. In the classic cell (private support, shared decoys, private irrelevant facts), R1 reaches 96.7% [93.3, 99.4] on Qwen and 97.2% [93.9, 99.4] on Llama, and R1-rel changes accuracy by − 22.2 -22.2 points [ − 28.9 -28.9 , − 16.1 -16.1 ] and − 20.0 -20.0 [ − 26.1 -26.1 , − 13.9 -13.9 ] (Figure 4 ). The relevance tier admits about two shared decoys while retaining slightly less support; because shared decoys carry four holder tags, R1-rel also keeps fewer facts in this cell (8.3 to 8.5 against 9.0 for R1).
blocks.zh: 平均将收益和巨大损失结合起来。 在经典格(私人支持,共享诱饵,私人无关事实)中,R1在Quen上达到96.7%[93.3,99.4],在Llama上达到97.2%[93.9,99.4],R1-rel变化精度为−22.2-22.2分[−28.9-28.9,−16.1-16.1]和−20.0-20.0[−26.1-26.1,−13.9-13.9](图4). 关联级承认了大约两个共享的诱饵,同时保留了稍少的支持;由于共享的诱饵带有四个持有者标记,R1-rel在这个单元格中也保存较少的事实(8.3到8.5对9.0对R1).

blocks.en: The failure persists when relevance is known exactly. With evaluator labels that mark both support and decoy facts as relevant, oracle relevance minus R1 is − 23.3 -23.3 [ − 30.6 -30.6 , − 16.1 -16.1 ] for Qwen and − 31.1 -31.1 [ − 38.9 -38.9 , − 23.9 -23.9 ] for Llama in this cell, so filter errors cannot explain the loss. An oracle that marked only support facts would no longer select by relevance; it would select by the answer key. The same holds on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, whose filter is nearly perfect (relevant-class precision 99.4% and recall 98.9%, against recall 66.0% on Qwen and 85.6% on Llama), yet in the same cell R1-rel minus R1 is − 32.2 -32.2 [ − 40.6 -40.6 , − 24.4 -24.4 ] and oracle relevance minus R1 is − 29.4 -29.4 [ − 37.8 -37.8 , − 21.7 -21.7 ]. Relevance separates the decision criteria from other attributes, whereas usefulness depends on the balance of evidence between competing options, which a relevance filter does not see.
blocks.zh: 在确切了解相关性时,失败依然存在。 由于评价者标签上标注了相关的支持和诱饵事实,甲骨文相关性减去R1是−23.3-23.3 [−30.6-30.6,对Quen来说是−16.1-16.1],对Llama来说是−31.1-31.1 [−38.9-38.9,−23.9-23.9],因此过滤错误无法解释损失的原因。 仅标出支持事实的甲骨文不再按相关性来选择;它将按答案键来选择。 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上也是如此,其滤波器几乎是完美的(相关的-级精度为99.4%,召回98.9%,而Quen的召回率为66.0%,Llama的召回率为85.6%),但在同一细胞中,R1-R1减R1是−32.2-32.2 [−40.6 -40.6,−24.4 -24.4],甲骨文相关性减R1是−29.4 -29.4 [−37.8 -37.8,−21.7 -21.7]。 相关性将决定标准与其他属性区分开来,而实用性则取决于相互竞争的选项之间证据的平衡,而相关性过滤器看不出这一点.

blocks.en: The kept evidence explains these results across policies. Pooling the four copy policies, accuracy rises monotonically with the net lead of the correct option among the kept facts, counted as in the answer key: from 13.5% and 10.3% at a lead of − 2 -2 to 76.0% and 75.6% at + 2 +2 and 96.2% and 96.1% at + 4 +4 or more on Qwen and Llama. In a template random-intercept logistic model with this lead and the tone of the kept irrelevant facts, the policy terms (R1-rel, B4, and Random against R1) are no longer distinguishable from zero. Wrong answers are mostly the decoy: in the classic cell, B4 picks it in 71.1% and 63.3% of decisions. The decision model therefore follows the keyed evidence closely, and memory policies differ mainly in which balance of evidence they hand it.
blocks.zh: 所保存的证据解释了各项政策的这些结果。 将四个复制政策集中起来,准确性与所保存的事实中正确选项的净领先率单调上升,在回答键中计算:在Qwen和Llama上,从13.5%和10.3%的领先率-2-2升到76.0%和75.6%+2+2,96.2%和96.1%以上。 在带有这种铅和保留不相关事实的基调的模板随机拦截后勤模型中,政策术语(R1-rel,B4和Random against R1)不再与零区分. 错误的答案大多是诱饵:在经典细胞中,B4在71.1%和63.3%的决定中选择它. 因此,决策模式密切遵循关键证据,记忆政策主要在它们提交的证据平衡方面有所不同。

blocks.en: 5.4 The Decision Model Follows Social Proof
blocks.zh: 5.4 决策模式遵循社会证据

blocks.en: The all-facts memory is not a neutral reference. It contains every fact and gives the correct option a two-point lead in every variant, so a reader that ignored ownership would be equally accurate across cells. Instead, accuracy is 21.0 points [16.5, 25.6] higher on Qwen and 13.8 [9.7, 17.9] higher on Llama when support facts are shared rather than private. In the classic cell the all-facts memory reaches only 54.4% and 55.6%, about 40 points below the R1 memory built from the same facts under a 60% budget (Figure 5 ).
blocks.zh: 全事实记忆不是中性参考. 它包含每个事实,并且给正确的选项在每个变体中一个两点的领先,因此一个忽略所有权的读者会同样准确跨细胞. 相反,Quen的准确度是21.0分[16.5,25.6],而Llama的准确度是13.8分[9.7,17.9],因为支持事实是共享的,而不是私人的。 在经典的细胞中,全事实内存只达到54.4%和55.6%,低于60%的预算(图5)根据同样事实建立的R1内存大约40点。

blocks.en: Each memory line begins with the tags of the agents who stated it, and much of this preference follows the tags (Figure 5 ). Without tags, the shared-support advantage of the all-facts memory falls from + 21.0 +21.0 to + 7.2 +7.2 points on Qwen and from + 13.8 +13.8 to + 7.6 +7.6 on Llama. Removing them raises classic-cell accuracy by + 14.4 +14.4 points [7.8, 21.1] on Qwen, + 13.3 +13.3 [6.7, 20.0] on Llama, and + 24.4 +24.4 [17.2, 32.2] on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, where it goes from 72.8% to 97.2%. The tags, not the line order, carry this effect: both conditions keep the transcript-derived order, and reassigning the same tag sets to facts at random, again with order fixed, also raises classic-cell accuracy, by + 12.8 +12.8 points on both open models. The effect is not simply an error. Where support is shared and decoys are private, removing the tags lowers Qwen’s accuracy by − 10.6 -10.6 points [ − 16.7 -16.7 , − 4.4 -4.4 ]: the model treats a fact stated by many agents as more credible, which helps when the widely held facts are the useful ones and misleads when they are not. In CrossProfile the shared facts were assigned to every agent rather than observed independently, so the tags carry no extra evidence. On a common 30-template subset the tagged gap is + 17.8 +17.8 on Qwen, + 12.5 +12.5 on Llama, + 6.1 +6.1 on DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and + 7.2 +7.2 on DeepSeek-V4-Pro. This attribution effect is an analogue of the common-knowledge effect that arises after the discussion rather than during it, and it accounts for part of R1’s advantage in the classic cell: R1 drops the shared facts that the decision model overweights.
blocks.zh: 每条内存行从声明的代理的标记开始,这种偏好大多沿用标记(图5). 没有标记,全事实记忆的共享支持优势从Qwen上的+21.0+21.0降至+7.2+7.2分,从Llama上的+13.8+13.8降至+7.6+7.6. 移除后提高经典细胞精度,在Quen上加+14.4+14.4分[7.8,21.1],在Llama上加+13.3+13.3[6.7,20.0],在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上加+24.4+24.4[17.2,32.2],从72.8%升至97.2%. 标记,而不是线条顺序,都带有这种效果:两个条件都保留了笔录衍生的顺序,并且将同一个标记套随机地重新分配给事实,再次固定顺序,也提高了经典细胞的精度,在两个开放模型上加12.8+12.8分. 效果不仅仅是一个错误。 如果支持是共享的,而诱饵是私人的,去掉标记会降低Qwen的准确度-10.6-10.6分[−16.7-16.7,−4.4-4.4]:模型将许多代理商所说的一个事实视为更可信,这有利于当被广泛持有的事实是有用的事实时,当它们不是时误导. 在CrossProfile中,共享的事实被分配给每一个特工而不是独立观察,所以标记没有附加证据. 在一个常见的30倍径子集上,标记的缺口是:Quen上的+17.8+17.8,Llama上的+12.5+12.5,DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上的+6.1+6.1,以及DeepSeek-V4-Pro上的+7.2+7.2. 这种归属效应是讨论后而不是讨论期间产生的共知效应的类似,它占据了R1在经典细胞中的部分优势:R1放弃了决定模型超重的共同事实.

blocks.en: 5.5 Natural Discussions Lose the Evidence Upstream
blocks.zh: 5.5 自然讨论失去证据上游

blocks.en: In natural discussions no memory policy is detectably better than another; R1 minus B3 is − 1.4 -1.4 points [ − 5.0 -5.0 , 2.4] on Qwen and − 3.1 -3.1 [ − 9.2 -9.2 , 2.7] on Llama (Appendix Table 16 ). The reason is visible before any memory is built (Table 3 ). The full transcript (REF) scores below an empty memory on all three models, and the group’s own final vote is correct in only 24 to 32% of discussions, although the same models reach 62 to 90% when given every fact. In DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash discussions, a string-matching heuristic finds private facts stated in full in only 1.7% [0.6, 2.9] of cases. Facts that were never stated cannot be recovered by any memory policy.
blocks.zh: 在自然讨论中,没有任何记忆政策比另一个政策好;R1减B3在Quen上为1.4-1.4分[−5.0-5.0,2.4],在Llama上为3.1-3.1[−9.2-9.2,2.7](附录表16)。 在构建任何内存之前,原因可见(表3). 所有三个模型的完整笔录(REF)得分都低于一个空的内存,而该集团自己的最终投票在只有24到32 %的讨论中是正确的,尽管同样的模型在给出每个事实时都达到了62到90 %. 在DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash的讨论中,一串匹配的heuristic发现只有1.7%[0.6,2.9]的案件充分陈述了私人事实. 任何记忆政策都无法收回从未申报的事实。

blocks.en: A prompt change helps one model only. Asking agents to state their evidence before recommending raises Llama’s REF accuracy by + 30.8 +30.8 points [21.5, 39.5], and by + 25.1 +25.1 [15.9, 34.4] in a paired ablation with fresh seeds, with no detectable change for Qwen (Appendix A.4 ). When the discussion carries more evidence, the memory policy matters again: under the evidence-first prompt, Llama’s R1 memory reaches 57.1% against 22.9% for B4 and 53.2% for B3, whereas in the original discussions the three were within three points of each other (29.2%, 29.4%, 32.3%; means over budgets, Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 迅速改变只会帮助一个模型。 要求代理商在建议提高Llama的REF精度前陈述其证据,其分数为+30.8+30.8分[21.5,39.5],在与新鲜种子成对的衰竭中以+25.1+25.1分[15.9,34.4]表示,对Quen没有可察觉的变化(附录A.4). 当讨论有更多证据时,内存政策再次重要:在证据第一提示下,Llama的R1内存达到57.1%,而B4的内存为22.9%,B3的内存为53.2%;而在最初的讨论中,这三点在彼此之间的三个点之内(29.2%、29.4%、32.3%);这意味着预算超支,附录A.4。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Neither rarity nor relevance is a safe default for the memory of an LLM group. In CrossProfile, rarity helps only in the ownership cells where rare facts support the answer, relevance readmits on-topic decoys even with a perfect filter, and the decision model follows social proof, giving extra weight to facts that many agents are tagged as stating. What drives the decision is the balance of evidence between options that the memory leaves, and how the reader weighs its attribution. Memory designs for agent groups should therefore aim at that balance rather than at prevalence or topic, and should not present how many agents stated a fact as evidence for it when the sources are not independent. Evaluations should vary who holds which evidence, and should check whether that evidence reached the discussion at all.
blocks.zh: 对LLM组的记忆来说,既无稀有性又无相关性是安全的默认. 在"CrossProfile"中,稀有性只在罕见的事实支持答案的所有权细胞中有所帮助,关联性连完美的过滤器都重新发送到专题诱饵上,而决定模型也遵循社会证据,给许多物剂被标记为声明的事实加分. 推动决定的是内存留下的选项与读者如何权衡其归属之间的证据平衡. 因此,代理人团体的记忆设计应着眼于这种平衡,而不是普遍性或专题,不应提出在来源不独立时有多少代理人将事实作为证据。 评价应不同谁掌握哪些证据,并应检查这些证据是否进入讨论。

blocks.en: A.1 Tasks, Policies, and Prompts
blocks.zh: A.1 任务、政策和提示

blocks.en: Benchmark Construction and Example
blocks.zh: 基准构建和实例

blocks.en: HiddenBench contributes 65 tasks: 58 have four agents and seven have three; 59 have three options and six have four. Its 503 facts comprise 250 shared and 253 private facts. Sixty facts contain several sentences and are kept as one unit. Controlled discussions disclose every assigned fact; natural discussions follow the benchmark’s two-round exchange with initial and final votes.
blocks.zh: 隐藏奔驰贡献65项任务:58项有4名特工,7项有3名;59项有3项选项,6项有4项选项. 其503项事实包括250项共同事实和253项私人事实。 60个事实包含若干判决,并作为一个单元保留。 受控的讨论披露了每一个指定的事实;自然的讨论遵循基准的两轮交换,并获得初始和最终票数。

blocks.en: CrossProfile has ten pilot and 60 main templates. The 60 main templates cover 12 decision domains with five templates each: hospital equipment purchase (M01–M05), school lunch vendor (M06–M10), city bus route (M11–M15), warehouse location (M16–M20), software hosting vendor (M21–M25), community clinic site (M26–M30), job candidate for a lab (M31–M35), conference venue (M36–M40), bridge repair contractor (M41–M45), farm irrigation system (M46–M50), library renovation (M51–M55), and emergency shelter site (M56–M60). Each main template has four agents, three options, and 12 facts. The support group contains three facts in favor of the correct option and two against the decoy option; the decoy group contains two facts in favor of the decoy and one against the correct option. The four irrelevant facts have two positive and two negative tones. The role structure is specified before the sentences are written, and facts receive neutral IDs in random order. Relevance refers to the stated criteria, not to whether a fact favors the answer.
blocks.zh: CrossProfile有10个飞行员和60个主要模板. 60个主要模板涵盖12个决策领域,各有5个模板:医院设备采购(M01-M05)、学校午餐供应商(M06-M10)、城市公共汽车路线(M11-M15)、仓库地点(M16-M20)、软件托管供应商(M21-M25)、社区诊所地点(M26-M30)、实验室职位候选人(M31-M35)、会议地点(M36-M40)、桥梁维修承包商(M41-M45)、农场灌溉系统(M46-M50)、图书馆翻新(M51-M55)和应急住所地点(M56-M60)。 每个主模板有四个代理,三个选项,12个事实. 支援组包含3个赞成正确选项的事实和2个反对诱饵选项的事实;诱饵组包含2个赞成诱饵的事实和1个反对正确选项的事实. 四个不相关的事实有两种正和两种负音. 角色结构在句子写成之前就已经指定,事实会按随机顺序收到中性ID. 相关性是指所述标准,而不是事实是否有利于答案。

blocks.en: Template M01 asks a hospital procurement panel to choose a scanner supplier, weighting purchase price, electrical safety, and repair response equally. The options are Brightline Imaging, Hallum Diagnostics, and Ostrava Clinical. Table 4 lists its facts with their evaluator roles. The eight variants change the ownership of the role groups while keeping every sentence fixed.
blocks.zh: Template M01要求一家医院采购小组选择一台扫描仪供应商,加权购买价格,电气安全,修理响应均匀. 选择是亮线成像法、Hallum诊断法和Ostrava临床法。 表4列出了委员会的事实及其评估者的作用。 八种变体改变角色组的所有权,同时保留每句固定.

blocks.en: Policy Details
blocks.zh: 政策细节

blocks.en: The claim inventory records each claim’s text, its set of contributors, and its first-appearance rank. Each memory line is written as [A1,A2] claim text , and the memory keeps the selection order. R1 sorts by contributor count and then by first appearance; B4 uses first appearance; Random uses a random order. M1 cycles through speakers, taking each speaker’s earliest unselected claim that fits, and then fills the remaining budget in first-appearance order. B3 summarizes the transcript instead of copying claims.
blocks.zh: 索赔清单记录了每件索赔的文本、其出资人组以及第一批出货人。 每个内存行都写为[A1,A2]索赔文本,内存保持选择顺序. 按贡献者计数的R1类型,然后是初次出现;B4使用第一次出现;Random使用随机顺序. M1通过演讲者循环,采用每位演讲者最早未选择的符合要求的主张,然后按第一出场顺序填充其余预算. B3总结了记录而非复制索赔。

blocks.en: For R1-rel, the filter is queried once per template, seed, and model, and its prediction is shared by all eight ownership variants. Statements are presented in random order. If no valid list of statement numbers is obtained after one retry, all facts are treated as relevant, which reduces R1-rel to R1. The predicted-relevant and remaining tiers are each sorted in R1 order.
blocks.zh: 对于R1-rel,过滤器每个模板,种子,和模型都会被询问一次,其预测由所有八个所有变量共享. 发言按随机顺序排列。 如果在一次重试后没有获得有效的语句编号列表,则所有事实都视为相关,这样将R1-相对比R1. 预测的相关等级和剩余等级按R1顺序排列。

blocks.en: Copy policies add whole claims and skip claims that would exceed the budget. CrossProfile budgets price every fact with all four holder tags in template order, while selected lines carry their true tags, so the budget is the same across variants but the number of items that fit is not. Summaries are asked for at most max ⁡ ( 1 , ⌊ B / 1.3 ⌋ ) \max(1,\lfloor B/1.3\rfloor) words, and longer outputs are truncated to the budget at a sentence boundary.

Arm A0 uses the original prompt; arms A1–A4 append the suffixes below to the first-round user prompt.

blocks.en: To check that the controlled R1 advantage over B3 does not depend on defining budgets as a ratio of the fact set, we also ran both policies with a fixed 128-token budget on controlled HiddenBench. There, R1 and B3 reach 81.0% and 52.3% on Qwen and 82.1% and 57.4% on Llama. This experiment used a 4,096-token context rather than the 8,192-token context of the main runs.
blocks.zh: 为了检查受控R1相对于B3的优势不取决于预算的定义是事实集的比例,我们还用固定的128个托肯预算在受控的隐藏奔驰上运行两种政策. 其中,R1和B3在Quen上达到81.0%,52.3%,在Llama上达到82.1%,57.4%。 这个实验使用了4,096个托肯上下文,而不是主运行的8,192个托肯上下文.
